description: OLE-PROP combinations of the Mode connection property (0 unspecified, read, write, read/write, read/write + deny none, read/write + exclusive, read/write + deny write, read + deny read): on a read/write copy a first Connection opens with the mode (State, Mode, properties Mode and Jet OLEDB:Database Locking Mode, a no-op UPDATE of Items, Errors), then a second Connection in the same process opens the same file with read/write + deny none (State, Errors, UPDATE attempt, Errors), then both close. Asks which mode combinations open, what each records and how the second open and the writes are affected.
